findings.oracle: Real input: production calls QMessageBox.warning opening a genuine modal in offscreen Qt; independent oracle: the exact title/text strings passed to warning(); exact assertion: warning_recorder.captured == [("Real Title", "Real warning body")] and ordered [("First","alpha"),("Second","beta")] for two dialogs. The mocking silence_qmessagebox fixture is gone; the autouse WarningRecorder driven by a real QTimer captures the genuine dialog and is now gated by two tests in the conftest (mutating the capture to a wrong title goes RED).

Real input: a real minimal PE built by _build_pe_binary opened through the bridge against the native intellicrack_hexcore backend; independent oracle: the DOS magic constant 0x4D 0x5A and pe_binary.stat().st_size; exact assertion: the yielded object isinstance HexEditorBridge with state.connected True, read_bytes(0,2)=="4D 5A", write 90 90 then read=="90 90", restore then read=="4D 5A"; plus error path read_bytes without document raises RuntimeError(match="no document open"). Proves the fixture yields a usable connected bridge, not None.

Real input: the real LocalProcessSandbox launches sys.executable as a genuine OS subprocess that writes one real file and emits fixed markers; independent oracle: the known program behaviour (exit 0, STDOUT-MARKER/STDERR-MARKER, artifact payload bytes); exact assertion: report.exit_code==0, stdout=="STDOUT-MARKER", stderr=="STDERR-MARKER", the real before/after tree diff yields a created FileChange for artifact.bin with size==len(payload) and the file bytes match; plus error paths run_binary timeout raises SandboxError(match="timed out") and copy_from_sandbox of a missing file raises SandboxError. InMemorySandbox retained only for pure-helper unit tests; the real backend is now gated (mutating the diff to drop created changes goes RED).
